description: 基于EgoEMS 67个Keysteps的意图字典v1.3路由特征包。在v1.2基础上新增negative_scope、scoring_definition、required_slot_policy与on_slot_missing优先级规则、可计算S_trg/S_prior/S_pref公式、结构化confusion_pairs以及路由器trace规范。out不参与路由打分。

route_feature_schema.act: assess_check | inquire_history | measure_vital | prepare_equipment | device_operate | patient_manipulate | explain_communicate | record_document | request_call | safety_clear | treatment_intervention | interpret_report | transport_move | secure_fix | notify_activate | handoff_report

scoring_definition.final_score_formula: w_trg * S_trg + w_prior * S_prior + w_pref * S_pref
